ResearchProjectDef.label: serum refinement
ResearchProjectDef.description: Advanced processing techniques allow anomaly serums to be purified and stabilized, increasing their effectiveness and reducing unwanted side effects. A single refined serum recipe automatically upgrades a usable vanilla dose or uses the equivalent raw materials. The original serum research is also required.

ResearchProjectDef.label: advanced serum engineering
ResearchProjectDef.description: Precision bioferrite processing and controlled void-derived catalysts allow serums to be pushed beyond their conventional limits. A single advanced serum recipe automatically uses a usable refined dose, a vanilla dose, or the equivalent raw materials. All alternatives require a shard and the original serum research.
